title: English Practice Quiz 0964
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Start with a capital letter and use a question mark.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: Please drive ___.
questions.explanation: Carefully is the adverb modifying drive.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'available'?
options: ready or able to be used
questions.explanation: Available means ready for use or accessible.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: She said, 'I can swim.'
options: She said that she could swim.
questions.explanation: Can commonly changes to could in reported speech after a past reporting verb.
